descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
As a Service Desk specializing in Dutch and German languages, you will serve as the first point of contact for end-user technical issues and requests. You will play a pivotal role in resolving technical challenges, upholding service level agreements (SLAs), and supporting HCLTech’s reputation for excellence in IT support across multiple client environments.
 Responsibilities 
Act as the initial point of contact for all end-user reported technical issues and service requests, providing support in Dutch, German, and English.
Take end-to-end ownership of user incidents and requests, ensuring timely resolution and thorough follow-up as per process requirements.
Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Remote Support Engineering or Field Engineering teams, as appropriate.
Monitor and maintain call quality, response times, and adherence to agreed SLAs, driving continuous improvement in service delivery.
Accurately document and update all customer interactions and case details in the system.
Provide technical support and customer service across multiple client accounts, upholding professionalism and client satisfaction.
Contribute to knowledge base updates, coach and train new team members, and participate in ongoing learning activities.
Analyze recurring issues, perform root cause analysis, and support process improvements.
Ensure compliance with quality standards, regulatory requirements, and company policies.
Strive for high customer satisfaction through first-call resolution and reduced case re-open rates.
 Requirements 
 Essential Qualifications 
 Advanced proficiency in Dutch and German (C1 level) , both written and spoken.
Previous experience in a technical helpdesk, IT Service Desk, or technical call center environment.
Proven experience providing technical support over the phone.
Willingness and flexibility to work in a 24/7 shift environment .
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to resolving technical issues.
Excellent communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
 Technical Skills and Experience 
 Operating Systems: Hands-on experience supporting Windows operating systems, particularly Windows 10. Knowledge of macOS is an advantage.
 Google Workspace: Experience troubleshooting and supporting applications such as Gmail, Google Drive, and Google Meet.
 IT Service Management (ITSM): Familiarity with ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or HP Service Manager.
 Active Directory & Exchange: Experience with user account creation and management, Exchange mailboxes, and distribution lists.
 Remote Support Tools: Experience using remote desktop and troubleshooting solutions such as Bomgar (BeyondTrust), WebEx, Microsoft Systems Management Server (SMS), and Windows Remote Desktop.
 Network Connectivity: Knowledge of VPN connections, remote access solutions, and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
 Hardware Support: Experience troubleshooting laptops, desktops, printers, and related peripherals.
 Mobile Device Support: Familiarity with supporting iOS and Android smartphones.
 Web Browsers: Experience troubleshooting common browsers, including Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Microsoft Edge.
 Desktop Applications: Knowledge of Adobe Acrobat, WinZip, and other commonly used business applications.
 Nice-to-Have Skills 
Experience supporting macOS environments.
